title: TradeStation Order
description: Schema for TradeStation order submission, modification, and group order operations. Covers single orders, bracket orders (OCO), and order-sends-order (OSO) strategies.

AccountID.description: The brokerage account identifier to place the order in.

Symbol.description: The symbol to trade, such as a stock ticker, option symbol, or futures contract.

Quantity.description: The number of shares, contracts, or units to trade.

OrderType.description: The type of order determining execution behavior.

TradeAction.description: The direction and intent of the trade.

TimeInForce.description: How long the order remains active before expiring.

LimitPrice.description: The limit price for Limit and StopLimit order types.

StopPrice.description: The stop trigger price for StopMarket, StopLimit, and TrailingStop order types.

Route.description: The routing destination for order execution. Use the routes endpoint to retrieve valid values.

GTDDate.description: The good-til-date expiration date when TimeInForce is GTD.

Legs.description: Option legs for multi-leg option orders.

AdvancedOptions.description: Advanced order options including trailing stop configuration.

Amount.description: The trailing amount in dollars. Mutually exclusive with Percent.

Percent.description: The trailing amount as a percentage. Mutually exclusive with Amount.

OptionLeg.description: A single leg of a multi-leg option order.

TradeAction.description: The trade action for this option leg.

GroupOrder.description: A group of related orders such as bracket (OCO), order-sends-order (OSO), or one-cancels-other strategies.

Orders.description: The individual orders that make up the group.

OrderResult.description: The result of an order submission, modification, or cancellation.

OrderID.description: The unique order identifier assigned by TradeStation.

Message.description: A human-readable message about the order result.

OrderStatus.description: The current status of the order.

OrderConfirmation.description: Pre-submission confirmation details including estimated costs.

EstimatedCommission.description: The estimated commission for the order.

EstimatedCost.description: The estimated total cost of the order.

MarginRequirement.description: The margin requirement for the order.
